leadText:
Believe in Me is the opening theme song for the English dub of the fifth season, Pokémon: Master Quest. It was used from Around the Whirlpool to Hoenn Alone!. A full version of the song, credited as I Believe, was used as the opening theme to Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias. The opening animation is composed of clips from the Whiteberry version of the opening Aim to Be a Pokémon Master that were not used in Born to Be a Winner, the fifth Japanese opening Ready Go!, a clip from the Japanese ending Face Forward Team Rocket!, and some episode clips from the season.

It was written by John Siegler and David Rolfe, and was performed by David Rolfe. It is available on the CD .
